text.description_html:
Acorn PR9YP, Hand Painted Aloha Single Flower Cabinet Knob

Perfect for all sorts of applications, be it in the kitchen, the bathroom, or on any light weight door, Acorn's Aloha Single Flower Cabinet Knob will bring surfer style to your home. It is available in two colors, a light orange background with a dark orange flower or a light green background with a blue flower. The picture really doesn't due this cabinet pull justice. The hand painted colors round cabinet knobs are vibrant and mimic the Aloha spirit of the beach. The Flower Cabinet Knob has a 1-1/4" diameter.

Features of the Hand Painted Aloha Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
